introduction: Montana SNAP helps eligible households buy food. Public Assistance offers online, telephone and local-office application routes.
description: Montana SNAP helps eligible households buy food. Public Assistance offers online, telephone and local-office application routes.

sections.who: Household income, resources and other conditions apply. People buying and preparing meals together generally form a SNAP household; special grouping rules apply.
sections.get: Approved households receive food assistance through EBT. Expedited service is available for qualifying urgent cases.
sections.docs:

sections.apply:
1. Apply

    Use DPHHS’s SNAP page and apply.mt.gov, or call 888-706-1535.

  2. Explain urgent circumstances

    Ask about expedited screening.

  3. Complete case requirements

    Follow interview and verification instructions.
